tool.about: Match accelerator Programs to your company, then write an Application from a checked Form. Results and answers are shared with colleagues who have full document access. Submit on the Program's own website.

common.readOnly: You can read saved results and answers, but your role cannot edit them.
common.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
common.accessBody: Accelerators is available only to active company members with access to all company documents and the required document permissions. Ask a company administrator to review your access.
common.notFound: This saved item could not be found.

home.title: Accelerator Programs
home.description: Explore sourced Programs and your company's saved fit results. Opening this screen never starts paid matching.
home.matchHint: Matching compares all available Programs with the current company profile. A fit score is not a probability of acceptance.
home.profileMissing: Build the company profile in Settings → Company before matching or drafting with AI.
home.emptyBody: A trusted installation operator must import reviewed Program records. There are no sample or automatically generated results here.
home.applicationsHint: One company-shared Application per Program and Cycle. These answers are saved separately from grant proposals.
home.noApplications: No Applications yet. Open a Program to see whether a checked Form is available.

fit.title: Company fit
fit.staleHint: The company profile or Program changed since this result. Click Match Programs to update it; no rematch happens automatically.
fit.unmatchedHint: No saved fit assessment. Matching starts only when you choose Match Programs.

program.interpretation: Interpretation of the cited sources, not an additional eligibility rule
program.noCycles: No Cycle information has been confirmed.
program.notChecked: This current Form has not been checked. An Application cannot be started from an approximate or unconfirmed Form.
program.unsupported: This Form cannot be used in the editor. See the limitations below.
program.noFields: No checked Fields are available for this Form.
program.submissionNote: Starting saves a company-private copy of this Form. It does not submit an application or upload anything to the Program.

application.title: Application
application.description: Write and explicitly save each Field. Required Fields may be saved unfinished; review everything and submit on the Program's own website.
application.shared: Answers are shared with eligible colleagues in your company.
application.snapshot: This Application uses the Form captured when it was started. Later Catalogue changes do not replace its questions or answers.
application.refreshHint: Reloading preserves your unsaved text. Conflicting saved changes will be shown alongside it.
application.noFields: This Application has no editable Fields.
application.manualCount: {count, plural, one {# manual portal requirement} other {# manual portal requirements}}

field.saveFailed: Could not save this answer. Your local text is still here.
field.draftHint: AI drafts empty prose Fields only. Check its facts, citations, and missing information before submission.
field.draftFailed: Could not start the draft. Your answer has not been replaced.
field.draftRunning: A run is in progress. You can keep typing; a completed draft will not replace unsaved text.
field.editHint: Select part of your saved answer, say what to change, and review a replacement before anything is saved. Credits are used when a suggestion is generated, even if you discard it.
field.editNeedSelection: Select the text you want to change in the answer above.
field.editNeedSaved: Save your changes first. Selected-text edits apply to the saved answer.
field.editFinishFirst: Apply or discard the current suggestion before asking for another.
field.editInstructionPlaceholder: For example: make this clearer, or use the customer numbers from our profile
field.editFailed: Could not start the edit. Your answer has not been changed.
field.editRunning: A suggestion is being generated. If you change this answer first, the suggestion is discarded and you are not charged.
field.suggestionUnchanged: No change was made to the selected text.
field.suggestionCharged: {credits} credits were used to generate this suggestion. Discarding it does not refund them.
field.suggestionStale: The answer changed after this suggestion was made, so it can no longer be applied. Select the text again to get a new suggestion.
field.suggestionDirty: Save or undo your unsaved changes before applying this edit.
field.applyFailed: Could not apply the edit. Your answer has not been changed.
field.limitUnconfirmed: No confirmed length limit. Check the Program's portal before submitting.
field.limitNone: No numeric length limit recorded in the checked source.
field.manualFile: Upload this file yourself in the Program's portal. This editor does not store or upload files.
field.manualVideo: Record and provide the video yourself in the Program's portal. AI cannot create or upload this requirement.
field.conflictBody: Your local text has been preserved. Compare it with the latest saved answer before deciding which version to keep.
field.keepLocal: Keep my text for the next save

validation.characterLimit: This answer exceeds the confirmed character limit.
validation.wordLimit: This answer exceeds the confirmed word limit.
validation.invalid: Enter a valid value for this Field type.
validation.manual: Complete this requirement in the Program's portal.

run.pollFailed: Could not refresh the run status. Your local edits are preserved.

errors.runInProgress: An accelerator run is already starting or running. Wait for it to finish before starting another AI action.
errors.fullAccess: Accelerators requires access to all company documents.
errors.profileRequired: Build the company profile before using AI.
errors.notFound: This Program, Application, or Field was not found.
errors.conflict: The data changed. Reload and try again without discarding your edits.
errors.invalid: Check the Field value, limits, and Form availability.
errors.credits: There are not enough credits for this action.
errors.internal: The action failed. Your saved answers have not been replaced.
